The system avoids false data activation by enforcing strict lineage checks. In GSI, these map to Bayesian nodes where evidence from loaders and fixtures updates belief in readiness scores. GSE uses this structure to simulate player states and predict outcomes. Failure occurs when snapshot integrity is breached or when fixture data is mislabeled. The dual nature of data—static vs. dynamic—requires distinct handling in both systems. The kernel of insight lies in the interplay between access control (rights gates) and data validity (proof reports), which together define a secure, traceable data lattice.
